entries.title: Workflow Agent
entries.description: A Workflow Agent is an AI-assisted software component that helps complete a defined business process, such as triaging enquiries, drafting follow-ups, updating records, or routing exceptions for human review.

entries.title: Agentic AI
entries.description: Agentic AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that can autonomously perceive their environment, reason about goals, and take actions to achieve them without constant human supervision.

entries.title: Human-in-the-Loop AI
entries.description: Human-in-the-loop AI is a way of designing AI workflows so that a person reviews and approves important actions before they take effect, instead of the AI acting fully on its own.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models to securely connect to data sources and tools, standardized by Anthropic.

entries.title: Order Automation
entries.description: Order automation is the use of software to capture, check, and route customer orders with less manual data entry, while people keep control of approvals and exceptions.

entries.title: Order-to-Production Handoff
entries.description: An order-to-production handoff is the process of turning a confirmed customer order into clear instructions that a production or packing team can act on, without manual re-entry between systems.

entries.title: Purchase Order Automation
entries.description: Purchase order automation is software that reads incoming purchase orders, extracts the important details, checks them against business rules, and prepares them for approval and entry into an order system, reducing manual re-keying.

entries.title: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
entries.description: RAG is a technique that optimizes the output of an LLM by referencing an authoritative knowledge base outside its training data before generating a response.

entries.title: WhatsApp Automation for Singapore Businesses
entries.description: WhatsApp automation for Singapore teams: qualify leads, capture orders, update CRM or Sheets, and hand off to staff. From S$3,000; API fees separate.
